en.headline: 3 own commits, 20 automated, 4 issue actions, 1 discussion reply
en.summary: sogeisetsu made 3 own commits across 2 repos, plus 20 automated commits by github-actions[bot] in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 2 own commits updated agent docs and fixed daily-report commit attribution to support aliases for non-GitHub email addresses. In `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory`, 1 own commit tagged the `v1.15.5` release. On issues, the user opened `openchamber/openchamber` #4920 about the context panel breakdown bar dividing whole-session estimates by the last message's input, commented on #4111 about orphaned MCP child processes after deleting a multi-run, and commented on then closed #4346 about `SidebarHeader.test.tsx` still passing after `onOpenMultiRun`/`canOpenMultiRun` were removed in `d9fbf6b`. Separately, `yulia-ivashko` closed `openchamber/openchamber` #4345 about the command palette 'Parallel run' sharing the checkbox-multiple icon with sidebar 'Select sessions'. The user also joined an existing discussion, `openchamber/openchamber` #4821 on adding session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel. No pull requests, reviews, or releases were recorded; no section was truncated.

zh.headline: 3 次本人提交、20 次自动提交、4 个 issue 操作、1 条讨论回复
zh.summary: sogeisetsu 在 2 个仓库完成 3 次本人提交，另有 20 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交，均位于 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中，2 次本人提交更新了 agent 文档，并修复了 daily 报告的提交归属逻辑，使其支持别名以兼容非 GitHub 账号邮箱的提交。在 `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` 中，1 次本人提交打了 `v1.15.5` 发布标签。issue 方面，用户新开了 `openchamber/openchamber` #4920，反映上下文面板 breakdown 条把整段会话估算除以最后一条消息的输入，导致「其他」恒为 0%；在 #4111 上留言，讨论删除 multi-run 后遗留的 MCP 子进程以及 `git worktree remove --force` 报 Permission denied；在 #4346 上留言并关闭，该 issue 关于 `d9fbf6b` 移除 `onOpenMultiRun`/`canOpenMultiRun` 后 `SidebarHeader.test.tsx` 仍然通过。此外，`yulia-ivashko` 关闭了 `openchamber/openchamber` #4345，涉及命令面板「Parallel run」与侧边栏「Select sessions」共用 checkbox-multiple 图标。用户还参与了一条已有讨论，`openchamber/openchamber` #4821，主题为在 Context Usage Panel 中增加会话聚合统计。当日无 PR、review 或 release 记录；各分区均未截断。
